::: research-lead

## Publications {#publications}

::: pub-intro

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const pubs = document.querySelectorAll(".pub[data-themes]");
  const btns = document.querySelectorAll(".pub-filter");
  const sections = document.querySelectorAll(".pub-group");
  function apply(f) {
    btns.forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("is-active", b.dataset.filter === f));
    pubs.forEach(p => { p.hidden = !(f === "all" || p.dataset.themes.split(" ").includes(f)); });
    sections.forEach(s => {
      const items = s.querySelectorAll(".pub[data-themes]");
      if (items.length) s.hidden = [...items].every(p => p.hidden);
      else s.hidden = f !== "all";
    });
  }
  btns.forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => apply(b.dataset.filter)));
  document.querySelectorAll(".theme-card").forEach(c => c.addEventListener("click", () => {
    apply(c.dataset.filter);
    document.getElementById("publications").scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth"});
  }));
});
</script>
```
